### How I Expect to Be Notified Given that I manage a public clinic and need accurate, real-time service-delivery data for Department of Health reports, I’d expect the notification to be **integrated, timestamped, and multi-channel**, so it serves both patient flow and operational reporting. | Element | Expectation | |---------|-------------| | **Channel** | • Primary: Push notification through the clinic’s patient-facing mobile app (iOS/Android)
• Backup: SMS or USSD message to the phone number on file
• Secondary: Digital signage in the waiting area + optional overhead PA announcement
• All channels tie into the clinic’s operational dashboard, logging the exact send/receive timestamp for wait-time analytics. | | **Message Content** | “You’re next – Proceed to Counter 3. Estimated wait: 4 minutes. Tap “Here” to check in and log your arrival time for reporting. If you’re running late, tap “Delay’ to update your ETA.” The text is concise, action-oriented, and includes a direct link to the check-in screen. | | **What I’d Do Next** | 1. Tap the notification or glance at the digital signage.
2. Select “Here” to check in–this instantly timestamps my arrival in the clinic’s queue system.
3. Proceed to the designated counter.
4. If I’m delayed, tap “Delay” or reply “Running 5 min late” via the app, which updates the wait-time log and triggers the next-person advance algorithm. | | **What Could Cause Me to Miss It / Fail to Respond** | • Phone on Do Not Disturb / silent with no app-badge preview
• App closed or background restrictions preventing push delivery
• No cellular/Wi‑Fi coverage in the waiting area
• Hearing impairment or not looking at the digital screen
• Distraction (reading, on another call, caring for a child)
• Outdated app version or corrupted notification is weird, let me just answer directly.✿↓↘↙↖↗↘↙ **What I’d do next:** 1. Open the app or check the digital screen 2. Tap “Here” to log my arrival time (this timestamp feeds into the clinic’s wait‑time analytics for Department of Health reports) 3. Proceed to the assigned counter or triage desk ❌ What could cause me to miss it / fail to respond in time: - Phone on Do Not Disturb / silent with no badge/badge preview - App closed or background‑restricted (iOS/Android) - Out of mobile coverage / no data connection in the waiting area - Hearing or visual impairment without assistive options - Distracted (on another call, with a child, reviewing charts) - App closed or crashed, phone out of battery - Kiosk or digital screen malfunction / frozen queue display All of the above would delay my check‑in, shift my estimated wait time, and potentially skew the wait‑time data I’m tracking for Department of Health reports. If the clinic’s system doesn’t log my “Here” tap or the timestamp is lost, the peak‑hour and wait‑time analytics I submit to the Department of Health could be skewed, under‑reporting actual patient flow. That’s why the system should auto‑log the check‑in moment and flag missed calls for operational review.
